concerns.text: FR-003 (reconstruct relative 3D bounding‑box dimensions) is not addressed – T011 only runs the solver and writes pose estimates, but no task creates the required bounding‑box dimensions from those poses.
SC-004 (dataset‑filtering success rate) is missing – T007 writes the filtered CSV but no subsequent task computes or records the percentage of sequences retained versus total raw sequences.

Constitution I (Reproducibility) is weakened – T002 creates a requirements.txt that lists package names but does not pin exact version numbers, violating the non‑negotiable reproducibility rule that all dependencies must be version‑pinned.

Constitution I also requires random seeds to be pinned in code; no task in the checklist explicitly sets or documents fixed random seeds for any stochastic component (e.g., synthetic fallback generation, line‑detection randomness), constituting a silent weakening of the reproducibility guarantee.
